$Stage Random Pool (Silly Melee) [Synapse]
*As the Stage Random Pool code, for Silly Melee: A+Y skips the preload refresh, which crashes Silly,
*and the next stage loads when the match starts. Tested on Silly Melee v1.01. Offline only.
*SIZE: 329 code lines of the ~408 that Dolphin (and console loaders) hold for ALL enabled codes together;
*if the enabled codes go over, NONE of them is applied. It doesn't fit with the Character Random Pool code.
*Synapse, Copyright (c) 2026 w3irDv, MIT licence: https://github.com/w3irDv/20XX-Synapse_Engine
*Don't enable it on a Synapse ISO that already bakes this feature (it would hook the same code twice).
